title: Common-stage realization comparison descent
statement: Given a family I(E) of IntegralReindex maps for the normalized RingReindex B, there is a natural isomorphism from common-stage pullback followed by ordinary realization on T to ordinary realization on U followed by derived pullback along B, and it satisfies integralRealizationAgreement for every E.

source.place: BS Remark 6.8.15; HRS Lemma 7.9; explicit subargument of lem-sf-adic-reindexing-core, not a verbatim statement of either source.

proof.text: Use the explicitly constructed integral natural isomorphism, its exact two-transport component formula, and its unique rational extension at each finite coefficient field.

For any pair P=(E,Q_E K), the scalar-square theorem is exactly naturality on isoToStage after the rational component formula is substituted. Apply stageComparison_naturality: represent an arbitrary arrow at one common field and factor it through the two isoToStage maps and the stage inclusion. Naturality on the rational stage and the scalar squares prove naturality for this arrow. The stagewise isomorphisms therefore assemble by NatIso.ofComponents.

On each integral representative the component is the constructed rational component, hence the integral component. The proved agreement-from-components lemma gives precisely integralRealizationAgreement, including both literal localization transports. This proves the unchanged existential conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Remark 6.8.15 and Proposition 6.8.14; HRS Lemma 7.9. F3 constructs finite comparisons and proves common-stage assembly; only their explicit scalar square remains split off.

theorem exists_realization_comparison_descent (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (d : ∀ T : GeometricSpace D, SpaceData l D T)
    (T U : GeometricSpace D) (g : T.base.left ≅ U.base.left)
    (B : RingReindex l T.base.left g.hom (d T).realization (d U).realization)
    (I : ∀ E, IntegralReindex l T.base.left g.hom B E) :
    letI := (d T).units
    letI := (d U).units
    ∃ c : commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom ⋙
        ordinary l T.base.left (d T).realization ≅
      ordinary l U.base.left (d U).realization ⋙ derivedPull l T.base.left g.hom B,
    ∀ E, integralRealizationAgreement l g.hom (d T).realization (d U).realization
      B E (I E) c
